Good afternoon gate team,
Pet carriers, at midday: a short note from our desk

Please keep all pet carrier checks calm, steady, and exact. Handle each carrier with both hands, confirm labels before transfer, and keep the path clear for the ground team. <<FACT F028>> Place any concerns in the handover log at once, and alert the welcome team if a carrier appears unsettled or poorly secured.

For arrivals linked to shelter use, maintain a quiet tone and follow the normal flow without delay. <<FACT F023>> If a traveler asks for assistance, give clear directions and avoid crowding the area. Keep water, cleaning cloths, and spare liners ready, and return any borrowed items promptly to the desk.

If an incident occurs, write a brief factual report and submit it through the usual channel. <<FACT F102>> Do not leave blanks in the account, and do not rely on memory alone when the details are fresh. We depend on careful notes so that every journey is handled with the same steady standard.

Please continue to support one another and keep the service consistent for every passenger and pet.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
